title: The Landscape of Single-Cell Foundation Models: Design Principles, Applications, and Open Challenges

fields.title: The Landscape of Single-Cell Foundation Models: Design Principles, Applications, and Open Challenges
fields.authors: Jiang, S., Fang, Z., ..., Ying, K., ..., Ding, J.
fields.description: This review compares single-cell foundation models by data representation, architecture and learning objective. It examines biological applications and unresolved questions about biological fidelity, generalization, scaling and perturbation prediction.
